nodes.label: Gateway pre-registration with fixed token (working path)
nodes.rationale: Pre-register the gateway participant with an owner token, then start opc-gateway with fixed EDGE_GATEWAY_ID/EDGE_GATEWAY_TOKEN credentials so restarts do not rotate the token.

nodes.label: First human (owner) registration on a fresh server
nodes.rationale: Only allowed unauthenticated on a fresh server; the resulting owner bypasses capability evaluation (participant.manage check) and can register the gateway participant.
